label: New Product Approval Compliance Review
description: Assesses new financial products against regulatory requirements, risk appetite, and compliance frameworks. Produces structured approval recommendation with conditions.

claudeKnowledge.description: MiFID II product governance, EU PRIIPs, CRD/CRR, PSD2/PSD3, consumer protection requirements

guidedInputs.label: Product description
guidedInputs.description: Describe the new product: what it is, how it works, target market, pricing, and key features.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Fixed-term savings product offering 3.5% interest for 12-month deposits, minimum €10,000. Available to retail and SME customers. No early withdrawal option. Interest paid at maturity. Target market: risk-averse retail savers seeking guaranteed return. Distribution: online and branch.

guidedInputs.label: Known regulatory concerns or constraints
guidedInputs.description: Any regulatory issues the business team has already identified, or constraints from legal or risk.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Concerns about early withdrawal restrictions under consumer credit directive. Unclear whether product triggers PRIIPs KID requirement. Previous similar product raised questions from regulator about target market definition.

guidedInputs.label: Jurisdiction(s)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Sweden (Finansinspektionen), Nordic region, EU cross-border
